news.title: GODSpeed — first playable build is here
news.body: The first working build of GODSpeed is live in the launcher. Race and explore the solarpunk island of Eline: drive Chaos-physics cars against AI rivals, watch cinematic replays, buy land and build a sea-to-fuel industry chain while the island city grows around you.

games.title: GODSpeed
games.description: Race, build and grow on the solarpunk island of Eline. Drive the VS Lens and four tiers of Chaos-physics cars, race AI rivals that learn your lines, watch cinematic replays, buy land, build a sea-to-fuel industry chain and watch the island city grow around you.

games.title: VS Lens Configurator
games.description: Configure the VS Lens in the Veldboom factory showroom: both bodies, paints and finishes, wheels, and the aero kit piece by piece. Run the wind tunnel on whatever you have built — a solved airflow field you can probe with the smoke wand, with drag, downforce, balance and separation read off the car as you change it. Indicative pricing — not final.

files.title: De Veldboom — Vertical Farming Tower
files.description: Print-ready STEP files for the De Veldboom vertical farming tower: the 6-hole tower segment that screws into the base (Verticalfarmingdoublev9), planter cup, reservoir base, lid, rainhead, grow-light ring, sponge layer + bucket, sprout rack, plus the full tower assembly. Click the eye icon to inspect a part in 3D before downloading.
